Problem it solves: Find every face in an image/frame, with landmarks, fast enough for video
Solution used: SCRFD (InsightFace) - one pass gives bounding box + 5 landmarks; ONNX/TensorRT-ready

Problem it solves: Faces appear at different angles/scales, hurting recognition
Solution used: 5-point similarity transform (Umeyama) to a canonical 112x112 crop; identical in train and inference

Problem it solves: Blurry / dark / tiny / non-faces poison the template and matches
Solution used: Proxy FIQA: detector score + sharpness + exposure thresholds; low-quality samples skipped (hook for CR-FIQA)

Problem it solves: Masks/sunglasses/caps degrade recognition silently
Solution used: Heuristic occlusion estimator tags mask/sunglasses/cap regions so confidence can be interpreted

Problem it solves: Same person across frames should be one identity, not many
Solution used: Lightweight IoU tracker assigns stable track IDs (hook for ByteTrack / DeepStream nvtracker)

Problem it solves: Turn a face into a comparable numeric identity
Solution used: ArcFace (w600k_r50, InsightFace) -> 512-d embedding; occlusion-aware EdgeFace+AdaFace planned

Problem it solves: Single-frame embeddings are noisy / unstable
Solution used: Run heavy recognition once per track on gated frames and average embeddings across the track

Problem it solves: Match one face against many enrolled identities, at scale
Solution used: FAISS cosine IndexFlatIP; sub-ms for up to ~1M identities; swappable for Milvus/Qdrant

Problem it solves: Raw per-frame hits are not human-readable
Solution used: IdentityLog merges appearances over short gaps; clusters unknowns by similarity; emits JSON report

Problem it solves: Register a person's face robustly from a few images
Solution used: Detect largest face -> align -> quality gate -> average accepted samples into one 512-d template

Problem it solves: Stop one face being registered to multiple accounts
Solution used: Search new template against gallery; reject (409) if it matches a different user above threshold

Problem it solves: Identify all people in an uploaded video without blocking the UI
Solution used: Async FastAPI BackgroundTask -> per-frame pipeline -> report JSON + annotated MP4 + timing stats

Problem it solves: Non-technical users need a browser workflow
Solution used: FastAPI + Uvicorn serving login + role-aware dashboard; webcam capture, upload, results in-browser

Problem it solves: Persist accounts and templates; keep vector store rebuildable
Solution used: SQLAlchemy + SQLite (Postgres-ready); DB is source of truth, FAISS rebuilt from it on every change

Problem it solves: Never store plaintext passwords
Solution used: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with per-user salt; constant-time compare (hmac.compare_digest)

Problem it solves: API was open; needed to know who is calling
Solution used: Bearer-token sessions issued at login/register, stored in a sessions table; resolved per request

Problem it solves: Operators and ordinary people must not have the same powers
Solution used: Roles user|authority; FastAPI deps current_user / require_authority guard each endpoint (401/403)

Problem it solves: Anyone could self-grant operator powers
Solution used: Authority signup gated by a shared access code (OCCLUBIO_AUTHORITY_CODE env var)

Problem it solves: Authority must be able to delete a subject and their biometrics
Solution used: DELETE /api/users/{id}: removes account, enrollment, sessions, messages; rebuilds FAISS index; cannot self-delete

Problem it solves: Authority needs to communicate with participants
Solution used: Message table; POST /api/messages (direct or broadcast); users read GET /api/me/messages

Problem it solves: Adding role to an existing live DB would break it
Solution used: Tiny additive migration adds users.role if missing (Alembic in production)

Problem it solves: Baseline ArcFace fails under heavy occlusion
Solution used: Synthetic occlusion augmentation + AdaFace quality-adaptive loss on an EdgeFace backbone; ONNX export plugs into inference

Problem it solves: Run real-time on NVIDIA Jetson cameras
Solution used: DeepStream / TensorRT config templates; FP16/INT8 path (~8-15 ms/face expected)

Problem it solves: Biometric system is legally sensitive (EU AI Act, India DPDP)
Solution used: Documented consent/DPIA, template protection, anti-spoof, bias eval, HTTPS as deployment prerequisites
